result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d increase humanity’s capacity for empathy and understanding.

So many conflicts, inequalities, and misunderstandings seem to grow from an inability or unwillingness to truly see other people’s experiences. If people could more easily understand one another — across cultures, beliefs, and circumstances — cooperation, kindness, and justice would likely follow more naturally.
